content.short: Hyperliquid is a high-performance perpetual DEX built on its own L1 featuring a native on-chain order book.
content.description:
Hyperliquid is a leading decentralized perpetual exchange built on its own dedicated Layer 1 blockchain, optimized specifically for high-speed financial operations. The platform features an on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) that delivers a professional trading experience similar to top-tier centralized exchanges, with sub-second execution and deep liquidity. By operating on its own chain, Hyperliquid eliminates the constraints of general-purpose networks, allowing for a highly specialized and scalable trading infrastructure.

In addition to perpetual contracts, Hyperliquid supports spot trading and native asset management, all secured by a decentralized validator set. The protocol is powered by the HYPE token and follows a community-first approach, prioritizing transparency and user sovereignty. As a cornerstone of the modern derivatives landscape, Hyperliquid provides a robust and non-custodial venue for traders seeking institutional-grade performance in a decentralized environment.
